doc: Conformance vectors exported from TailFirmware host tests (roadmap QA-5). Ground truth: every result and read payload was produced by the real firmware command dispatch and state serialiser (main/app_bridge.cpp), not hand-written. Regenerate with test/host/conformance/regenerate.sh. char is a characteristic's short UUID low byte (write: 1=FF01 3=FF03 6=FF06 8=FF08; read: 2=FF02 4=FF04 6=FF06 8=FF08 7=FF07). hex is space-separated bytes. Each step's result is the RESULT_* code the write produced. reads[] is the state on the named read characteristic after all steps. NOTE: FF06 (char 6) has no internal framing - every block is located by parsing the ones before it, so a captured FF06 read is a POSITIONAL contract and those vectors are brittle by nature: appending a block anywhere but the documented end silently misreads every block after it.

cases.name: motion_select_pattern_wagging
cases.desc: Select the wagging pattern from a fresh boot.

cases.name: motion_select_pattern_static
cases.desc: Select the static pattern; pattern_id 0 on FF02.

cases.name: motion_select_pattern_unknown
cases.desc: An unknown pattern id is rejected UNKNOWN_ID.

cases.name: motion_select_pattern_bad_length
cases.desc: SELECT_PATTERN with no id is BAD_LENGTH.

cases.name: motion_set_pattern_param
cases.desc: Set pattern param 0 after selecting a pattern.

cases.name: motion_set_pattern_param_bad_length
cases.desc: SET_PATTERN_PARAM missing the value is BAD_LENGTH.

cases.name: motion_set_axis_limits
cases.desc: Set axis-0 travel limits; reflected in FF02.

cases.name: motion_set_axis_limits_inverted
cases.desc: Inverted axis window (min >= max).

cases.name: motion_set_axis_limits_oor
cases.desc: Axis index past MAX_AXES.

cases.name: motion_set_pid_retired
cases.desc: Retired SET_PID (0x04) is rejected UNKNOWN_CMD (v6).

cases.name: motion_set_motion_limits
cases.desc: Set per-motor open-loop limits on motor 0; reflected in the FF06 motion block.

cases.name: motion_set_motion_limits_oor
cases.desc: SET_MOTION_LIMITS for a servo past MAX_SERVOS.

cases.name: motion_enable_motors_disable
cases.desc: Force motors off; motors_enabled clears in the FF06 motion block.

cases.name: motion_enable_motors_bad_length
cases.desc: ENABLE_MOTORS with no flag byte.

cases.name: motion_calibrate_zero
cases.desc: CALIBRATE_ZERO takes no payload and clears a stall latch.

cases.name: motion_set_motor_scale
cases.desc: Per-motor command scale (MOT-2).

cases.name: motion_set_motor_scale_zero
cases.desc: A zero motor scale would read as a dead motor; rejected.

cases.name: motion_set_gentle_scale
cases.desc: Global gentle-mode speed scale (MOT-4).

cases.name: motion_set_gentle_scale_oor
cases.desc: A gentle scale above 1.0 is out of range.

cases.name: motion_set_tap_enable
cases.desc: Enable tap detection on IMU 0.

cases.name: motion_set_tap_config
cases.desc: Tap tuning for IMU 0 (MOT-10).

cases.name: motion_set_axis_mix
cases.desc: Identity axis mix (MOT-0).

cases.name: motion_set_axis_mix_bad_gain
cases.desc: A zero gain makes the mix non-invertible; rejected.

cases.name: motion_set_behavior_enabled
cases.desc: Arm the behavior engine (MOT-6).

cases.name: motion_begin_sequence
cases.desc: Arm a keyframe-sequence upload into slot 0 (MOT-8).

cases.name: motion_select_sequence
cases.desc: Select slot 0 as the sequence PATTERN_KEYFRAME plays (MOT-8).

cases.name: motion_unknown_command
cases.desc: An unallocated motion command id.

cases.name: led_set_layer_rainbow
cases.desc: Set a rainbow on layer 0 over an explicit matrix.

cases.name: led_fully_specified_single_layer
cases.desc: Matrix + a static-color layer with every param pinned + the output stage: an FF04 state fully determined by commands rather than by boot defaults.

cases.name: led_set_layer_unknown_effect
cases.desc: An unknown effect id is UNKNOWN_ID.

cases.name: led_set_layer_bad_blend
cases.desc: A blend mode past the enum is UNKNOWN_ID.

cases.name: led_set_layer_oor
cases.desc: A layer index past MAX_LED_LAYERS.

cases.name: led_set_param_on_empty_layer
cases.desc: A param write to an in-range layer that has no effect.

cases.name: led_set_param_bad_param_id
cases.desc: A param id past the 8 slots.

cases.name: led_remove_layer_trims_trailing
cases.desc: Matrix + a fully-pinned layer 0, a layer 1, then remove layer 1: num_layers drops back to 1 and the FF04 state is fully determined by commands.

cases.name: led_remove_layer_oor
cases.desc: Remove a layer past MAX_LED_LAYERS.

cases.name: led_set_transform
cases.desc: Flip/mirror flags on a set layer.

cases.name: led_set_layer_enabled
cases.desc: Disable a set layer.

cases.name: led_set_opacity
cases.desc: Per-layer opacity (LED-2).

cases.name: led_set_direct_mode
cases.desc: Enter direct-drive mode (FF0A takeover).

cases.name: led_set_output_cfg
cases.desc: Master brightness + gamma + current limit (LED-1). ACK only: the surrounding FF04 state is a distinct device instance (the fully-specified case pins the output block).

cases.name: led_set_frame_rate
cases.desc: A valid frame rate (LED-6).

cases.name: led_set_frame_rate_oor
cases.desc: A frame rate past the ceiling is rejected, not clamped.

cases.name: led_set_frame_rate_bad_length
cases.desc: SET_FRAME_RATE with no fps byte.

cases.name: led_unknown_command
cases.desc: An unallocated LED command id.

cases.name: system_set_matrix
cases.desc: Describe a three-ring matrix. ACK only: FF04's layer stack is a distinct device instance (the fully-specified LED case pins the matrix header).

cases.name: system_set_matrix_bad_length
cases.desc: A ring count larger than the payload carries.

cases.name: system_set_device_name
cases.desc: Set the advertised name (SYS-6).

cases.name: system_set_device_name_too_long
cases.desc: A name past MAX_DEVICE_NAME_LEN is refused, never truncated.

cases.name: system_forget_all_bonds
cases.desc: BOND_INDEX_ALL clears the whitelist regardless of count.

cases.name: system_forget_bond_oor
cases.desc: A bond index no device could hold is out of range.

cases.name: system_select_descriptors_effect
cases.desc: Select an effect's parameter descriptors (SYS-9).

cases.name: system_unknown_command
cases.desc: An unallocated system command id.

cases.name: ota_begin_same_version
cases.desc: A BEGIN claiming the running version has nothing to install.

cases.name: ota_begin_too_small
cases.desc: A BEGIN whose length is under the image header is a bad image.

cases.name: ota_finalize_without_begin
cases.desc: FINALIZE with nothing armed is BAD_STATE.

cases.name: ota_abort_idle
cases.desc: ABORT is always OK, even with nothing in flight.

cases.name: profile_save_slot2
cases.desc: Save into slot 2; occupancy flips in FF08.

cases.name: profile_save_oor
cases.desc: A slot past MAX_PROFILE_SLOTS.

cases.name: profile_load_empty
cases.desc: Loading an empty slot is BAD_STATE.

cases.name: profile_rename
cases.desc: Save then rename slot 0; the name appears in FF08.

cases.name: profile_delete
cases.desc: Save then delete slot 0; occupancy clears.

cases.name: profile_unknown_command
cases.desc: An unallocated profile command id.

cases.name: profile_save_then_load
cases.desc: Save then load slot 0; the load is accepted and raises CONFIG_CHANGED on FF07.
